summary: Tested CRITICAL stock corruption bug fix in DC creation endpoint POST /api/job-work/challans. All 5 tests passed. The fix correctly reads item_current_stock from each item document in the deduction loop instead of using stale variable from check loop.
passed_tests: CRITICAL: DC creation with multiple items - each item's stock deducted from ITS OWN current_stock (Item A stock=10, Item B stock=200, both deducted correctly)
Inventory transactions show correct previous_stock and new_stock for each item (no cross-contamination)
Insufficient stock check still works - blocks DC creation when ANY item has insufficient stock
Multiple items (3+) with very different stock levels (5, 100, 1000) - all deducted correctly without cross-contamination
critical_code_review_comments: Backend (server.py lines 5928-5930): FIX VERIFIED - Now reads item_current_stock = item.get('current_stock', 0) from fresh item document in deduction loop
Backend (server.py lines 5941-5942): Inventory transaction correctly uses item_current_stock for previous_stock and new_stock
The bug was a classic Python variable scope issue: loop variable 'current_stock' from first loop (stock check) persisted and was incorrectly used in second loop (deduction)
Fix properly renames to 'item_current_stock' and reads from fresh item document for each iteration
seed_data_creation: Test items (components, raw materials), suppliers, SC orders, and DCs created during backend testing with unique UUID suffixes for isolation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRITICAL stock corruption bug fix verified. The bug was: 'current_stock' variable from stock-check loop leaked into deduction loop, causing Item A's stock to be set to (Item B's stock - Item A's quantity). Fix: Now reads item.get('current_stock', 0) from fresh item document in deduction loop. Test with items having VERY different stock levels (e.g., 10 vs 200 vs 1000) to catch cross-contamination.

bug_fix_verification.bug_description: Variable 'current_stock' was NOT re-read for each item in deduction loop - retained value from last item in stock-check loop
bug_fix_verification.example_before_fix: PT-1 (stock: 0) and RM-2 (stock: 2500). First-pass ends with current_stock=2500. Second-pass deducts: PT-1 new_stock = 2500 - 4 = 2496 (WRONG!)
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Now reads item_current_stock = item.get('current_stock', 0) from fresh item document in deduction loop
bug_fix_verification.verification_status: VERIFIED - All tests pass with correct per-item stock deduction
